description: Source code for CUDA scaled BLAS operations in PyTorch, including functions for checking tensor scaling recipes for different quantization schemes (fp8, fp4) and scaling types (tensorwise, rowwise, blockwise).

methods.name: check_tensorwise_recipe
methods.description: Checks if the tensor scaling recipe is tensorwise with float scales for fp8 types.

methods.name: check_rowwise_recipe
methods.description: Checks if the tensor scaling recipe is rowwise with float scales for fp8 types.

methods.name: check_nvfp4_recipe
methods.description: Checks for a two-level NVFP4 scaling recipe with specific scaling types and float scales.

methods.name: check_nvfp4_recipe_single_scale
methods.description: Checks for a single-scale NVFP4 scaling recipe with blockwise fp4 quantization.

methods.name: check_deepseek_recipe
methods.description: Checks for a deepseek recipe with specific blockwise fp8 quantization for A and B.

methods.name: check_mxfp8_recipe
methods.description: Checks for a blockwise fp8 recipe with specific scaling types and scales.

methods.name: check_mxfp4_recipe
methods.description: Checks for a blockwise fp4 recipe with specific scaling types and scales.
